# AliKit source snapshot

Punks vendors the `tree_model` and `tree_view` packages from
`samanshaiza004/alicorn-kit` commit
`856447e2083a2261d8f5b01a8ca436142f597de5` under the MIT License. The source
is included so native builds do not require a separate AliKit checkout.

Update the packages from a reviewed upstream commit and change this pin. Keep
the Punks adapter limited to public AliKit and Alicorn APIs.
